त्वक्ष् {c1c} P. (त्वक्षति, त्वष्ट)
1 To pare,
hew, peel.
--2 To make thin.
--3 To
cover.

त्वष्ट p. p. Made thin, pared,
peeled &c.

त्वष्टिः f. Carpentry. --m. N. of a
mixed tribe (?).

त्वाष्ट्र a. [त्वष्टा देवता अस्य अण्]
Belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ;

.
--ष्ट्री
1 The asterism चित्रा.
--2 A small
car.
--ष्ट्रं The creative power.

त्वंकारः Addressing
disrespectfully with a ‘thou’, theeing and
thouing.

त्वंग् {c1c} P. (त्वंगति)
1 To go, move.
--2 To jump, gallop.
--3 To tremble.

.
--4 Any cover or coating.
--5
The sense of touch.
--Comp.
--अंकुरः
horripilation.
--इंद्रियं the organ of
touch.
--कंडुरः a sore
--गंधः the
orange.
--छेदः {1} a skin wound, scratch,
bruise. {2} circumcision.
--जं {1}
blood. {2} hair (on the body).
--तरंगकः a wrinkle.
--त्रं an armour;
त्वक्त्रं चाचकचे वरं

.
--दोषः
disease of the skin, leprosy.
--परिपुटनं peeling of the skin.
--पारुष्यं
roughness of the skin.
--पुष्पः
horripilation.
--(ष्पी, --ष्पं) a blotch,
scab.
--भेदः a scratch.
--मलं hair of
the body.
--रोगः leprosy &c., any
cutaneous disease.
--सारः (
त्वचिसारः) a bamboo;
त्वक्साररंध्रपरिपूरणलब्धगीतिः Śi. 4. 61.
--सुगंधः an
orange.

To cover with
a hide.
--2 To peel off the skin.

त्वाच a. (ची f.) Relating to the
skin, contagious.

त्वच्य a. Conducive to the
healthiness of the skin.

त्वद् A form of the second
personal pronoun occurring as the first
member of some compounds: e. g.
त्वदधीन, त्वत्सादृश्यं &c.

त्वदीय a. Thy, thine, your,
yours;
त्वद्विध a. Like thee or you.

त्वर् {c1c} A. (त्वरत, त्वरित तूर्ण) To
hurry, make haste, move with speed,
do anything quickly; भवान्सुहृदर्थे
त्वरतां

. --Caus. (त्वरयति)
1 To cause
to hasten, expedite, urge forward,
accelerate; त्वरयोर्वशीं

त्वरा, त्वरिः f. [त्वर्-अङ्]
1 Haste,
hurry, speed; औत्सुक्येन कृतत्वरा
सहभुवा व्यावर्तमाता ह्रिया

त्वरा, त्वरिः f. [त्वर्-अङ्]
1 Haste,
hurry, speed; औत्सुक्येन कृतत्वरा
सहभुवा व्यावर्तमाता ह्रिया

त्वरित p. p. Quick, swift, speedy.
--तं
Despatch, haste. --ind. Quickly,
fast, speedily, hastily.

त्वष्टृ m. [त्वक्ष्-तृच्]
1 A
carpenter, builder, workman.
--2
Viśvakarman, the architect of the gods.
[Tvaṣṭṛ is the Vulcan of the Hindu
mythology. He had a son named Triśiras
and a daughter called संज्ञा, who was
given in marriage to the son. But she
was unable to bear the severe light of
her husband, and therefore Tvaṣṭṛ
mounted the sun upon his lathe, and
carefully trimmed off a part of his bright
disc; cf. आरोप्य चक्रभ्रमिमुष्णतेजास्त्वष्ट्रेव
यत्नोल्लिखितो विभाति.

. The part
trimmed off is said to have been used by
him in forming the discus of Viṣṇu,
the Triśūla of Śiva, and some other
weapons of the gods].

त्वादृश्, त्वादृश (शी f.) a.
Similar to thee or you, of thy kind;
